title: Teaching himself guitar after hearing Eddie Lang
summary: Hearing Eddie Lang made him decide to be a guitarist; he taught himself unorthodox voicings over years.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

So I had just been engulfed in music, just surrounded by music all my life. Now, how I started playing guitar. I heard Eddie think I had Eddy Lang, and I made up my mind I was going to play, be a guitarist. And I really taught myself, because I would hear certain voicings on a guitar, and I would just fool with it until I got just the voicings I wanted, which was kind of unorthodox. And it took an awful lot of work, I guess it took years and years and years for me to develop, you know, the strength, I guess, to do these things.
